notes.title: Goalgetter Out Now
notes.notes:
Independent development studio netmin games has announced that Goalgetter, a first-person football manager game, will be released on Steam today.

 Goalgetter is a football career simulation game where players take on the role of a young, ambitious striker aspiring for success in prominent European leagues, aiming to secure a professional spot through rigorous training or by garnering support from fans and the coach.

The game provides vast gameplay, encompassing international championships, diverse match options, and the ability to replay historic World Cup tournaments, offering a comprehensive football experience.

Additionally, it features an authentic football experience through its impressive 3D graphics, interactive scenarios set in diverse locations, and engaging elements like Ailton's insights, detailed statistics, and humorous events.

notes.title: Character creation, training and matchday in the World Cup demo
notes.notes:
Today we'll go into more detail about character creation, training and matchday in the World Cup demo of Goalgetter and have a few new screenshots for you.

[h2]1st character creation: [/h2]
🌟 Skill Points: You decide! Do you want to be the air-headed giant or the lightning-fast winger who skilfully avoids the offside trap?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/b07f965510dfd8d7e855a50cb9528630537fb15c.jpg[/img]

🔄 Character traits: Choose carefully! Every positive trait comes with a challenge. The leader on the field? Yes, but also stubborn. The creative game designer? Keep in mind, he tends to be selfish.
🌠 Special abilities: Choose two unique skills that can give your player the edge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/946fb3bc24a594dd8ae6a6532a2d67dbc412ef99.jpg[/img]

[h2]2nd Training: [/h2]
💪 Full throttle or strategy? Do you give it your all in training or save energy for the big game? Your decision could still prove important.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/59e1a6774fcfdfa5295016354c8fa31e7494ceb9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Matchday 3:[/h2]
📋 Lineup: Your coach will tell you if you start. No starting spot? Maybe you can call in a favor. Or settle for a spot on the bench or in the stands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/79063194fb5d7b02483fa1be2f2826051aa09d48.jpg[/img]

⚽Live ticker & tactics board: Follow the game live, analyze the tactics and interact with the coach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/48a81a191d1abe3ce7dd7d6a0b173d8941c5d257.jpg[/img]

🥅Game-changing moments: When the opportunity presents itself, YOU make the decision. Do you take the shot yourself or pass it? Your player's skills and the opposing goalkeeper's skills could make the difference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/26da25550304a025aeadc9d72ad1452bc056a042.jpg[/img]

The question is: Will your decisions, skills and strategies make the difference? Will you be the Goalgetter?

notes.title: This is what awaits you in the World Cup demo of Goalgetter!
notes.notes:
[h2]Immerse yourself in the history of football:[/h2]
Revive two of the most memorable World Cups - the 1954 World Cup and the 2022 World Cup. Experience these championships from a whole new perspective and write your own football history.

[h2]Character editor:[/h2]
Your Identity: Create your own national player. From the appearance to the background - everything is in your hands.
Distribute skill points: Every player is unique! Distribute your points wisely between speed, technique, strength and many other skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/d88acd28bc8ad685dd4879a6978b82bb9c63d15a.jpg[/img]

[h2]National team menu:[/h2]
Squad overview: Who are your teammates? Find out everything about the strengths, weaknesses and characteristics of your fellow players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/a8027db8376ce1f0a8d2b65cfc166b7f83c99cb8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Squad hierarchy: [/h2]
Find out where you stand in the team hierarchy and work your way up.
Matches: When are the next games? Who are the opponents? Prepare strategically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/6ece571d2162582637542af1f4076b9f18238034.jpg[/img]

[h2]Calendar menu:[/h2]
All games at a glance: A clear, chronological overview of all upcoming games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/d46a838bca16fa80caac43616d189fea570c1b51.jpg[/img]

[h2]Trainer menu:[/h2]
Interactions: Communicate with your trainer. Influence his opinion of you through conversations, gifts, or other actions.
Opportunities to play: The better the relationship with the coach, the higher the likelihood of playing regularly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/921c439f97e3f8b2d8be1e4cf42e1c4cc4d54c96.jpg[/img]

[h2]Goal wall training:[/h2]
Skill Improvement: Use this feature to improve your skills. The better you train, the better you will be on the field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/d5c7606a9aa9abf591bd6cd61e67709281e98d65.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:
[h1][b]Club/National Team in Goalgetter[/b][/h1]

In Goalgetter, it will be important to play your way into the first eleven both in your own club and in the national team.
In order to have a constant overview of your own team, a click on the club pennant on your desktop will take you to the club details. 
In addition to various statistics and information about the next opponent, you can constantly view the lineup of your own club.
Clicking on the national flag on the desktop does the same. Here you get information about the upcoming and past tournaments, the test matches, the current squad and the lineup of the national team.

notes.title: Love of the game
notes.notes:
Ailton is an absolutely down-to-earth and likeable person. From the beginning he did everything to give us the best possible pictures and videos for the game. We started filming in the dressing room and in the press room. Everything went well so far. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/8d1091e6b3eb11488c46d0e17744859be8d077e4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/f24c047e5cd3b5c513ea1e63e6d02d9ad7e1523d.png[/img][/url]
Then we went onto the pitch. 

As soon as the ball came into play, Ailton was in his element. For the next 7-8 hours, the ball barely left Ailton's foot. In the breaks, we played with our star like 12-year-old kids - penalty shootouts, free kicks, shots from the center line. If you let us programmers out of the basement, you're usually lucky if you don't get injured just walking, but Ailton played with us like we were at his soccer level. That's love of the game. If you talk to him about the Bundesliga from the past, he can remember every game and every goal and his eyes light up.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/1f1595eff242fcc85dceca878b2aa07102582a74.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/a737063da55ed6c07e34fd96ab2ebc6bb264deef.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/bb76769c9abe99c1208c15c367c26e64931cfc5d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/f945a5a196632b1c6965e3d3f465b62667844d17.jpg[/img][/url]

I've been crazy about football for 40 years, but that day Ailton showed me why I love this game so much - a ball in the middle and everyone is equal and has fun together – that’s Ailton!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/deba56a5b0fa679bbc08aba4782a809978c1127a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/159a94c04535ee626b009bab271970a763500b83.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/2dad2522230e2a223d276b879bd1152e526f2d43.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/eec6d7d8167088c4765376861d61dc626fe97160.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.notes:
[b]The Training[/b]

A very important feature in Goalgetter is the training. You have the possibility to ask for "favors" from your teammates - which you have earned beforehand - and thus make a particularly good impression on the coach in the final training. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/45ce9629e12024daaea8ad11142687a59fdfce0d.png[/img]

You determine for each training day the assignment and whether you want to put in a special shift with your own focus. The whole thing is done by drag and drop. The personal coach can also be helpful in all of this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/523317797ec100c985fde0a8be750f20e8548668.png[/img]

In addition, you can determine how much you follow the trainer's instructions or whether you follow less and place more emphasis on improving other skills. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40875899/222a0fe3dc71fec7bba395fc7ffd7c48f70cafd7.png[/img]

The training diary and the development values can be viewed at any time, and the weekly schedule can be interrupted after each day.

[b]Ailton becomes the official face of Goalgetter![/b]
German champion, German cup winner, top scorer in the Bundesliga, Turkish cup winner, Serbian champion... 
The list of the greatest successes of Bundesliga icon Ailton cannot be summarised so easily in one sentence. 
Ailton is and was the top scorer in person, which is why none other than him will be in action on our cover and even in the game.
This also marks the end of our competition, in which you have participated actively.
The winners are:

notes.title: Goalgetter Discord server is live now!
notes.notes:
The first First-Person Football Manager gives you the chance to make your dream, of becoming a top striker in one of the major European leagues, come true. You are a young and very gifted football player. Now you are getting the chance to play in the first league.
